purpose: Illustrative stock photography for four homepage themes. The photos do not depict LF staff, LF-owned facilities or documented LF customer projects.
processing: Mechanical crop to 3:2 and resize to 1536x1024 / 960x640 WebP. No generative edits or logo removal.

photos.author: Vitaly Gariev
photos.reason: Patterns, samples, sewing equipment and garments show the apparel development journey in one coherent setting.
